title: Device Verification
subtitle: Verify devices to secure your messages

intro.title: Verify Device
intro.desc: Verify the other device by comparing emojis or scanning a QR code to ensure messages cannot be intercepted.

sas.desc: Compare these emojis with the other device. If they all match, click "Match".
sas.waiting: Waiting for the other side to confirm...
sas.matched: The other side confirmed a match
sas.mismatched: The other side marked a mismatch

qr.show_desc: Ask the other side to scan this QR code
qr.scan_desc: Point your camera at the other device's QR code
qr.not_supported: This device does not support scanning
qr.show_unavailable: QR code display is not yet available
qr.scan_unavailable: QR code scanning is not yet available

result.success_desc: Device verified. You can now communicate securely.
result.rejected_desc: The other side rejected the verification request.
result.cancelled_desc: The verification flow has been cancelled.

errors.unsupported_method: The other side does not support this verification method
